statement_map.email_excerpt: I am sorry for the trouble this has caused.
You told us that some of your students say the course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you wanted this fixed.
We opened one affected lesson link on a desktop browser, Safari and a phone, and the video played each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side.
Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording of the video loading and send it to us along with the lesson link.
We will raise this with our team and get back to you.
